Subject: Dedicated capacity MAP: stakeholder rally, evaluation plan & close timeline

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, this thread will serve as the kickoff for a focused Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for CloudWave's Dedicated Capacity purchase. Goal: align stakeholders, lock throughput targets for the eval window, and identify the procurement path to close within 6–8 weeks.

Quick proposed agenda for the initial runbook:
- Confirm internal roles & primary contacts (technical, procurement, executive sponsor)
- Baseline traffic and target throughput/latency for the eval (p95 target, token cost constraints)
- Eval window logistics: dates, test workloads, and acceptance criteria
- Procurement milestones: PO, MSA signature, reserved pool reservation
- Data/security checklist handoff (SOC2 artifacts + network/infra requirements)

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx (MAP draft) and throughput-baseline.csv (sample load profile).

Can you confirm who on your side will own the technical evaluation (integration tests) and who will handle procurement? If agreeable, we suggest the following 3-day technical ramp and a 14-day eval window starting the week of Sept 7.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min sync this week to review MAP and assign owners
2) We’ll provision a dedicated GPU pool quota for the eval once procurement confirms PO terms
3) Laura will own rollout coordination from Redwood side; Monica and Karthik will run the technical eval and tuning

Looking forward —

—Priyom Das
Principal Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

We'll validate during the eval but please note we have two distinct traffic patterns: bursty inference for our realtime service and a smaller batch reranking job. We want the eval to cover both.

Hi Ethan — great, thanks for confirming owners. A couple of clarifications from the engineering side: 

- Suggested eval structure:
  * Day 0–2: provisioning + smoke tests (connectivity, auth, sample prompts)
  * Day 3–5: throughput ramp to target (50% -> 100% -> 125% burst)
  * Day 6–14: steady-state acceptance window (collect logs, latency distributions, cost metrics)

- Acceptance criteria (proposal):
  * Sustained 150 rps across the realtime workload with p95 token latency < 200ms
  * Batch reranking job completes within the SLA window (we'll define exact threshold in the sync)
  * No functional regression on outputs for our canonical prompts (we'll run a small eval harness)

- Test data & access: Please provide a staging API key or a short-lived ingestion token and representative payloads. We can sign any necessary NDAs; also flagged the CloudWave_Security_Questionnaire.pdf as required for audit.

I'll volunteer Karthik as the on-call for infra changes and Laura will coordinate scheduling and billing/procurement handoff. We'll plan to document runbook steps in the Google folder (link below).

Monica
